description: Send an iMessage from the user's Mac. Creates a draft that the user's Mac agent picks up and dispatches via Messages.app. Returns the draft id; use get_draft_status to confirm delivery. Address it with EXACTLY ONE of `to` (a valid phone number in E.164 format, +14155551234, or an email address the recipient uses for iMessage) or `conversation_id` (an existing conversation from list_conversations — the ONLY way to reply in a GROUP chat; a 1:1 thread resolves to its recipient). If one of the user's outreach limits is reached — `outreach_limit_reached` (new conversations started in a rolling 24-hour window) or `unreplied_limit_reached` (conversations started in the last 7 days that nobody has replied to yet) — the message is STILL ACCEPTED and queued: the response carries meta.queued (reason, limit, used, resumesAt = the moment a slot frees on its own) and the draft's status is "held" until a slot frees (an older conversation ages out of the window, someone replies) or the user raises the limit in Settings — tell the user it is queued, not failed. Both limits apply only to a message that would START a 1:1 conversation; replies and follow-ups into existing conversations, and any reply into a group, are never held by them. A 403 recipient_opted_out means the recipient texted STOP: do not retry.

conversation_id.description: Send into an existing conversation (its `id` from list_conversations) — required for group chats. Omit when using `to`.

response_webhook_events.description: Optional. Subset of events the webhook subscribes to. Defaults to all events. Common values: "message_received".

response_webhook_url.description: Optional. HTTPS URL that will receive POST notifications when the recipient replies in this conversation. Persists across the conversation thread, not just the single send.

to.description: Recipient phone (E.164, e.g. "+14155551234") or email address. Omit when using conversation_id.

name: send_imessage
